reasons: All atomic fallback elements are expressly present in a single concise insertion: Vendor retention of generic tools and know-how, and a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for Customer's business.

Preferred level is not reached (no assignment of deliverables, no embedded Vendor IP licence, no Customer Data rights, no no-joint-ownership statement), which is consistent with the locked fallback target.

Minimality holds: the existing Garman ownership sentences, the Software/Documentation licence, Authorized Location fee mechanic and the Schedule "D" conversion obligations are untouched; nothing is rewritten. "(including the Modifications)" is a short clarifier that neutralises the contradiction with Garman's ownership of "Improvements or Modifications" rather than an extra bargain.

Intent preserved: the licence does not transfer title, so it coexists with "No title ... is transferred to Sparkling"; note only that "deliverables" is not a defined term in this agreement (the document uses "Work", "Software", "Documentation"), which is a drafting nit worth flagging in the rationale rather than a defect that defeats the fallback.
